heading.title: The Extinction, Suspension and Revival of Easements

article.title: Extinction by revocation.
article.content: An easement is extinguished when the servient owner, in exercise of a power reserved in this behalf, revokes the easement.
article.html:
39Extinction by revocation.

Section 39 · Chapter V · page 16 of the Act

An easement is extinguished when the servient owner, in exercise of a power reserved in this behalf, revokes the easement.
